profiles.notes: Supplemental qualification requirements for reviewed Bath computing, mathematics and natural sciences courses.

requirements.label: UCAS · September 2027 deadline
requirements.details: Apply through UCAS. The course page lists 13 January 2027 for both Home and Overseas applicants.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Natural Sciences BSc (Hons) · Application information

requirements.label: Category C · English evidence
requirements.details: If you do not meet the English GCSE requirement, the course accepts designated English qualifications. Examples include IELTS 6.5 overall and 6.0 in each component, PTE Academic 62 with every component at least 59, and TOEFL iBT on the new scale at 4.5 overall and 4.0 in each component for tests after 21 January 2026.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Computer Science BSc (Hons) · English language requirements

requirements.label: GCSE English or accepted equivalent
requirements.details: Meet English Language or English Literature GCSE grade 4/C, or use an accepted Category C English qualification.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Mathematics, Statistics and Data Science BSc (Hons) · GCSE requirements

requirements.label: Contextual offers · UK fee status and eligibility
requirements.details: Contextual consideration requires eligibility for UK fees as well as a published contextual criterion. Examples include eligible free school meals history or a combination of a qualifying home postcode and UK state school study. The standard course offer applies to the usual route.

source.title: Bath · contextual admissions criteria

requirements.label: GCE A levels · typical offer
requirements.details: Typical offer A*A*A, with Mathematics at A or above.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Computer Science BSc (Hons) · British qualifications

requirements.label: GCE A levels · contextual offer
requirements.details: Eligible applicants receive AAA or A*AB, with Mathematics at A or above.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Computer Science BSc (Hons) · British qualifications

requirements.label: GCE A levels · alternative offer
requirements.details: A*AA or A*A*B with at least A in Mathematics can be paired with an eligible project, including EPQ or IEPQ at A, an AS Further Mathematics A where it is not also an A level, or a fourth A level at B where the four include Further Mathematics. A separate Welsh Baccalaureate offer uses B in the Advanced Skills Baccalaureate Wales.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Computer Science BSc (Hons) · British qualifications

requirements.label: US Advanced Placement · typical offer
requirements.details: Three AP exams at grade 5, including Calculus BC. Calculus AB, AP Seminar and AP Research cannot count. Bath can consider advanced school work, including honours or dual enrolment, individually. A suitable associate degree route lists GPA 3.5 with Mathematics credit.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Computer Science BSc (Hons) · American qualifications

requirements.label: Computer Science · UCAS statement and selection
requirements.details: The intended subject should be clear in the UCAS personal statement. Assessment uses the application, qualifications and GCSE performance. Courses normally assess the UCAS statement alone. Some routes such as Access to HE or T Level involve an interview.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Computer Science BSc (Hons) · Selection process

requirements.label: Scottish Advanced Highers · Mathematics
requirements.details: The typical offer is AA in two Advanced Highers with Mathematics. Bath typically expects five Highers and prefers grades AAAAA in those subjects.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Computer Science BSc (Hons) · Scottish Highers

requirements.label: Other published British qualifications
requirements.details: BTEC Level 3 offer: D*D*D plus A in A-level Mathematics; Access to HE offer: 42 Distinction credits. Check the programme-specific subject and combined qualification requirements.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Computer Science BSc (Hons) · British qualifications

requirements.label: GCE A levels · typical offer
requirements.details: Typical offer A*A*A, including A* and A across Mathematics and Further Mathematics. Full A-level Further Mathematics is strongly preferred.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Computer Science and Mathematics BSc (Hons) · British qualifications

requirements.label: GCE A levels · contextual offer
requirements.details: Eligible applicants receive A*AB with A* and A across Mathematics and Further Mathematics.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Computer Science and Mathematics BSc (Hons) · British qualifications

requirements.label: GCE A levels · alternative offer
requirements.details: A*AA or A*A*B with A* and A across Mathematics and Further Mathematics can be paired with EPQ or IEPQ at A or another recognised project. The course page separately lists A*AAB or A*A*BB with B in the Advanced Skills Baccalaureate Wales.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Computer Science and Mathematics BSc (Hons) · British qualifications

requirements.label: Computer Science and Mathematics · UCAS statement and admissions tests
requirements.details: The UCAS statement should fit the joint degree. The programme assesses qualifications, GCSE results and the application. The course page says MAT and TMUA are no longer accepted. Interview is exceptional.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Computer Science and Mathematics BSc (Hons) · Selection and British qualifications

requirements.label: US Advanced Placement · qualification policy under review
requirements.details: The 2027 course page says it is reviewing the AP offer. The university does not accept SAT Subject Tests for direct entry.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Computer Science and Mathematics BSc (Hons) · American qualifications

requirements.label: GCE A levels · alternative offer
requirements.details: Exceptional AS Further Mathematics applicants can meet A*A*A including Mathematics A*, AS Further Mathematics A, and either STEP grade 2 or a Merit in GCE AEA Mathematics.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Mathematics BSc (Hons) · British qualifications

requirements.label: Mathematics · additional test conditions
requirements.details: For applicants with A-level Mathematics and Further Mathematics or other common qualifications such as the IB Diploma and Scottish Advanced Highers, STEP, MAT and TMUA are not used. In exceptional AS Further Mathematics cases a test may be required.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Mathematics BSc (Hons) · Additional Mathematics Tests

requirements.label: Mathematics · evidence in the personal statement
requirements.details: The UCAS application should show interest in Mathematics through relevant reading, topics explored or appropriate experience. Interviews are exceptional.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Mathematics BSc (Hons) · Selection process

requirements.label: GCE A levels · typical offer
requirements.details: The standard pattern is A*A*A including Mathematics A* and A in a second quantitative subject. With Further Mathematics, the pattern is A*AA or A*A*B with Mathematics A* and Further Mathematics at least B.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Mathematics, Statistics and Data Science BSc (Hons) · British qualifications

requirements.label: GCE A levels · contextual offer
requirements.details: Eligible applicants taking a second quantitative subject can receive A*AB with Mathematics A* and A in that subject. With Further Mathematics, the offer is A*BB with Mathematics A* and Further Mathematics B.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Mathematics, Statistics and Data Science BSc (Hons) · British qualifications

requirements.label: GCE A levels · alternative offer
requirements.details: The page lists project-qualified alternatives of A*AA or A*A*B with Mathematics A* and a second quantitative subject A. With Further Mathematics, A*AB may be paired with an accepted supplementary qualification. Separate Welsh Advanced Skills Baccalaureate combinations are listed.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Mathematics, Statistics and Data Science BSc (Hons) · British qualifications

requirements.label: US Advanced Placement · typical offer
requirements.details: Three AP exams at grade 5, including Calculus BC and a second quantitative subject. Calculus AB, AP Seminar and AP Research cannot count. Bath considers appropriate honours or dual-enrolment preparation individually. A suitable associate degree route lists GPA 3.5 with both Mathematics and a second quantitative subject.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Mathematics, Statistics and Data Science BSc (Hons) · American qualifications

requirements.label: Data Science · UCAS selection
requirements.details: The university usually assesses the UCAS application. Interviews are exceptional.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Mathematics, Statistics and Data Science BSc (Hons) · Selection process

requirements.label: Scottish Advanced Highers · quantitative subjects
requirements.details: Typical offer AA in two Advanced Highers with Mathematics and a second quantitative subject. Bath typically expects five Highers and prefers grades AAAAA.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Mathematics, Statistics and Data Science BSc (Hons) · Scottish Highers

requirements.label: Other published British qualifications
requirements.details: BTEC Level 3 offer: D*D*D plus A* in A-level Mathematics. Check the programme-specific subject and combined qualification requirements.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Mathematics, Statistics and Data Science BSc (Hons) · British qualifications

requirements.label: GCE A levels · typical offer
requirements.details: Typical offer A*AA with one permitted combination: Biology and Chemistry, Chemistry and Mathematics, Biology with Mathematics and Physics, or Chemistry with Mathematics and Physics. Qualifying Physics combinations take precedence. If taking Biology without Physics, the Biology and Chemistry route applies.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Natural Sciences BSc (Hons) · British qualifications

requirements.label: GCE A levels · contextual offer
requirements.details: Eligible applicants receive AAB. The Biology/Chemistry and Chemistry/Mathematics combinations each require A in both named subjects. Physics combinations require A in Mathematics and Physics and B in Biology or Chemistry.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Natural Sciences BSc (Hons) · British qualifications

requirements.label: GCE A levels · alternative offer
requirements.details: AAA or A*AB plus an approved project such as EPQ or IEPQ at A is possible with the required subjects at A. With Physics combinations the grades are AAA. Separate Welsh Baccalaureate and Core Mathematics/AS Mathematics or Statistics variants are listed.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Natural Sciences BSc (Hons) · British qualifications

requirements.label: US Advanced Placement · stream-specific offer
requirements.details: One stream accepts three AP grades of 5 including Chemistry and either Biology or Calculus BC. The Physics stream expects four grades of 5 including Calculus BC, Physics 1, Physics 2 and either Biology or Chemistry. At most one Calculus AP counts. AP Seminar and AP Research do not count.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Natural Sciences BSc (Hons) · American qualifications

requirements.label: US route · numeracy evidence
requirements.details: The usual numeracy routes are grade 3 or above in AP Calculus AB, Calculus BC, Statistics or Precalculus, SAT Mathematics 700, or ACT Mathematics 28. Bath may consider suitable diploma maths when these results are unavailable. Honours, dual enrolment and relevant associate degrees (GPA 3.5) are considered individually.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Natural Sciences BSc (Hons) · American qualifications

requirements.label: Natural Sciences · GCSE Mathematics
requirements.details: The published GCSE Mathematics benchmark is grade 6/B.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Natural Sciences BSc (Hons) · British qualifications

requirements.label: Natural Sciences · UCAS statement and interview
requirements.details: The statement should show subject interest, for example through reading, science activities or relevant experience. Bath usually uses the UCAS application. Applicants on some routes, including Access to HE, are interviewed.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Natural Sciences BSc (Hons) · Selection process

requirements.label: Scottish Advanced Highers · Natural Sciences
requirements.details: Applicants presenting Advanced Higher Physics need AAA in Mathematics, Physics and Biology or Chemistry. Other applicants use AA in Chemistry and either Biology or Mathematics. The guide typically expects five Highers and prefers at least AAAAB.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Natural Sciences BSc (Hons) · Scottish Highers

requirements.label: Other published British qualifications
requirements.details: BTEC Level 3 offer: D*DD plus A in A-level Mathematics; Access to HE offer: 39 Distinction credits. Check the programme-specific subject and combined qualification requirements.

source.title: Bath 2027 · Natural Sciences BSc (Hons) · British qualifications
